title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Emanuel Wilson (hamstring) logs full practice Monday
items.desc: Emanuel Wilson remained a full participant in practice on Monday.
items.impact: Wilson remains on track to be good to go for Wednesday's season opener against the Patriots.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ty Okada (hamstring) misses practice Monday
items.desc: Ty Okada did not practice on Monday.
items.impact: Okada missed his second straight practice. His status will need to be monitored on Tuesday ahead of Wednesday's season opener.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Julian Neal (quad) logs full practice Monday
items.desc: Julian Neal practiced in full again on Monday.
items.impact: Neal remains on track to be good to go for Wednesday's season opener against the Patriots.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Josh Jones (knee) limited in practice Monday
items.desc: Josh Jones remained limited in practice on Monday.
items.impact: Jones is on track to be good to go in his depth role in Wednesday's season opener.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Tory Horton (hamstring) limited in practice Monday
items.desc: Tory Horton remained limited in practice on Monday.
items.impact: Horton logged his second straight limited practice. It would still be a surprise if he plays on Wednesday, but it is a good sign nonetheless.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Nick Emmanwori (ankle) limited in practice Monday
items.desc: Nick Emmanwori remained limited in practice on Monday.
items.impact: It is the second straight limited session for Emmanwori. He remains unlikely to play on Wednesday, but he has a chance.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Anthony Bradford (knee) logs full practice Monday
items.desc: Anthony Bradford was a full participant in practice on Monday.
items.impact: Bradford should be a full-go on the offensive line in Wednesday's season opener against the Patriots.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: AJ Barner (oblique) logs full practice Monday
items.desc: AJ Barner was a full participant in practice on Monday.
items.impact: Barner remains on track to be a full-go for Wednesday's season opener against the Patriots.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Christian Barmore (knee) logs full practice Monday
items.desc: Christian Barmore was a full participant in practice on Monday.
items.impact: Barmore returns after missing practice on Sunday. He is on track to be good to go for Wednesday's season opener.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) officially misses practice Monday
items.desc: TreVeyon Henderson missed practice again on Monday.
items.impact: Henderson continues to trend towards missing Wednesday's season opener.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Jeremiyah Love: status improving for Week 1
items.desc: Jeremiyah Love is improving as the Cardinals approach Week 1. When asked about Love's status for the season opener, HC Mike LaFleur said "I feel good."
items.impact: Love has been struggling with a high ankle sprain injury for a few weeks now, but this is a promising sign for his return. The first round rookie should be in line for a nice workload, and he flashed serious ability in his limited preseason action.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Darius Slayton released by Giants
items.desc: The Giants released WR Darius Slayton.
items.impact: Slayton was set to make $13 million this season. He was the longest-tenured player on the Giants.

items.author: Jordan Epp
items.title: Zach Charbonnet (knee) has 'aggressive' return timeline
items.desc: Seattle Seahawks running back Zach Charbonnet has an "aggressive" timeline for his return from injury, says head coach Mike Macdonald.
items.impact: Charbonnet is opening the season on the physically unable to perform (PUP) list. He will miss at least four games, but he could be off the PUP list sooner than expected. Macdonald did not disclose specifics on Charbonnet's timeline. The fourth-year running back has scored 20 rushing touchdowns in the last two seasons and tore his ACL in January.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Ben Brown (knee) ruled out for season opener Wednesday
items.desc: Ben Brown has been ruled out for Wednesday's season opener against the Seahawks.
items.impact: Brown didn't travel with the Patriots to Seattle. He'll miss at least the first game with a knee injury.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Keaton Mitchell returns to practice Monday
items.desc: Keaton Mitchell was back at Chargers practice on Monday.
items.impact: Mitchell had missed the last six practices. His return on Monday is a good sign for his status heading into Sunday's season opener.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kayshon Boutte will play in Week 1
items.desc: Texans head coach DeMeco Ryans said Kayshon Boutte will play in Week 1 against the Bills.
items.impact: Boutte was acquired in a trade with the Patriots back on August 24. Ryans said he has been "picking up the playbook really well." He'll be a deep threat on the outside for CJ Stroud.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Alec Pierce (knee) expected to be ready for Week 1
items.desc: Alec Pierce (knee) is expected to be ready for Week 1 for the Indianapolis Colts against the Baltimore Ravens according to Stephen Holder.
items.impact: Pierce has continues to increase his workload in team practice without any setbacks, setting up the dynamic pass-catcher to take advantage of his role as the No. 1 wideout alongside tight end Tyler Warren for quarterback Daniel Jones against a tough Ravens defensive unit Sunday.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tyler Smith (thumb) undergoing surgery Tuesday
items.desc: Tyler Smith (thumb) will undergo surgery Tuesday and is expected to miss four-to-six weeks according to Adam Schefter.
items.impact: Smith's absence will leave a hole on the interior of the Dallas offensive line for head coach Brian Schottenheimer entering the 2026 for an offense expected to score in bunches for fantasy managers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Isaiah Bond (concussion) back at practice Monday
items.desc: Isaiah Bond returned to practice on Monday.
items.impact: Bond missed some recent practice time with a concussion. He remains off the fantasy radar heading into the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Sean Tucker (undisclosed) to be game-time decision Sunday
items.desc: Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles said Sean Tucker will be a game-time decision for Sunday's game against the Bengals.
items.impact: Tucker is dealing with an undisclosed injury. He enters the season in a depth role in the Bucs backfield.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Pittman Jr. (hamstring) practices Monday
items.desc: Michael Pittman Jr. practiced on Monday.
items.impact: Pittman missed time during training camp with a hamstring injury. He remains on track to be good to go for Sunday's season opener against the Falcons.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: DK Metcalf practices Monday
items.desc: DK Metcalf practiced on Monday.
items.impact: Metcalf missed time during training camp with an undisclosed injury. He remains on track to be good to go for Sunday's season opener against the Falcons.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Rome Odunze (leg) misses practice Monday
items.desc: Rome Odunze did not practice on Monday.
items.impact: Odunze left practice early last Thursday with an apparent right leg injury. His status for Sunday's season opener is up in the air.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kyle Monangai (knee) at practice Monday
items.desc: Kyle Monangai was at practice on Monday.
items.impact: Monangai was considered week-to-week to end training camp. His presence at practice on Monday gives him a chance to be available for Sunday's season opener.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: D'Andre Swift at practice Monday
items.desc: D'Andre Swift was present at practice on Monday.
items.impact: Swift left practice early last week due to what was reported to be a cramp. His presence at practice on Monday is a good sign for his status heading into this week's season opener.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Tee Higgins (heel) practicing Monday
items.desc: Tee Higgins (heel) is practicing for the Cincinnati Bengals Monday according to Ben Baby.
items.impact: Higgins returned to the practice field alongside superstar wideout Ja'Marr Chase (knee) after both were sidelined last week while managing their minor injuries. The wideout looks poised to be available to slot into his role as the No. 2 pass-catching option behind Chase in time for Cincinnati's Week 1 contest against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.

items.author: Chris Schommer
items.title: Ja'Marr Chase (knee) returns to practice Monday
items.desc: Ja'Marr Chase (knee) returned to practice for the Cincinnati Bengals Monday according to Ben Baby.
items.impact: Chase was sidelined last week after suffering a hyperextended knee in practice. The superstar wideout will look to increase his activity throughout the week ahead of a Week 1 matchup against the Tampa Buccaneers.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Darren Waller practices Monday
items.desc: Panthers TE Darren Waller practiced on Monday.
items.impact: Waller was seen catching passes from Bryce Young. It is unclear if he will play in Week 1 after signing with Carolina late in training camp.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jalen McMillan (knee) practices Monday
items.desc: Jalen McMillan took part in individual drills during practice on Monday.
items.impact: McMillan missed time during training camp with a knee injury. He remains hopeful to be good to go for Sunday's season opener.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Emeka Egbuka (toe) practices Monday
items.desc: Emeka Egbuka took part in individual drills at practice on Monday.
items.impact: It is a good sign for Egbuka's availability to open the season after missing time in training camp. His status will need to continue to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jessie Bates III (back) good to go for Week 1
items.desc: Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski said Jessie Bates III is "ready to roll" for Week 1.
items.impact: Bates suffered a minor back injury during training camp. He has been practicing.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Kenny Dyson Jr. returns to Vikings
items.desc: The Vikings signed EDGE Kenny Dyson Jr. to their practice squad.
items.impact: Dyson will enter the season in a depth role on the defensive line for Minnesota.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Taylor Rapp returns to Broncos practice squad
items.desc: The Broncos brought back Taylor Rapp to their practice squad.
items.impact: Rapp will remain in a depth role for Denver heading into the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: George Kittle (Achilles) seen practicing Monday
items.desc: George Kittle was seen practicing on Monday.
items.impact: Kittle was on the field on Monday in Australia. It keeps him on track to be good to go for Thursday's seaaon opener, though it remains unclear if he will be facing any sort of snap count.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Jonathon Brooks works off to side with trainers Monday
items.desc: Jonathon Brooks was seen working off to the side with trainers on Monday.
items.impact: Head coach Dave Canales said last week that he was "very optimistic" that Brooks would play in Week 1. It remains unclear what the exact injury is that he is dealing with. His status will need to continue to be monitored the rest of the week.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Van Jefferson signs with Commanders practice squad
items.desc: The Commanders signed WR Van Jefferson.
items.impact: Jefferson was recently released by Washington. He will add depth in the wide receiver room for the Commanders.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Cooper Rush to serve as backup QB in Week 1
items.desc: Cooper Rush will backup Tua Tagovailoa in Week 1 against the Steelers.
items.impact: Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski said Michael Penix Jr. (knee) will be inactive to open the season.

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.title: Michael Penix Jr. (knee) to be inactive in Week 1
items.desc: Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski said Michael Penix will be inactive for Week 1 against the Steelers.
items.impact: Penix remains without a clear timetable to return to the field. Stefanski declined to put a timeline on when Penix could be ready to take the field. Tua Tagovailoa was named the starter for Week 1.

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.title: Tua Tagovailoa named Falcons starter
items.desc: Tua Tagovailoa has been named the Falcons starting QB.
items.impact: After a camp that was full of negative reports, Tua has managed to win the starting job. Frankly, it's likely by default, as Michael Penix just got back to practice after suffering a torn ACL last season. It will be interesting to see how long Tua can keep the job.
